title.value: System and method to prevent power supply failures based on data center environmental behavior

abstract_excerpt.value: Information handling system includes first and second power supplies and a management controller. Controller activates first power supply during normal operation and shuts down the second. In test mode roles are reversed to verify second power supply operates within limits; non-compliance indicates failure.

abstract_excerpt.value: Controller for managing power requests within an IHS during cluster operations; transfers any active delegated process to another resource before allowing a power operation such as shutdown or reboot, preventing process interruption or failure.

abstract_excerpt.value: Warranty recommendations for users selected based on warranty selections of peer users, expert user advice, and cost-based impact assessment. Users clustered into peer groups by industry or market segment using primary variables (workload type, market segment) and secondary variables (VM size, cluster size, cost, downtime). New users matched to top similar user via vector distance; current warranty of top similar user recommended. Expert star ratings and cost-based impact assessments also incorporated.

title.value: Managing Usage of Resources in a Hybrid Computing Environment

abstract_excerpt.value: Optimizes active and inactive components and resources in a hybrid computing system blending private and public resources to minimize costs and maximize performance. A learning model analyzes past and present usage metrics versus performance or cost criteria. Cost factors incorporate wear: higher wear equates to less preferred use due to reliability and warranty costs. When activating a private system component, deactivation of a high-wear component is delayed to allow integration; public resources may be used during this delay.
